text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm Narita Top Road.
...I want to become stronger.
Strong enough that I won't lose to my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And so—
I want to aim for it together with you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Answering those expectations, we'll rack up wins together.
...And reach the summit that lies beyond!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
